summary: Phase 20 roster authority for the revised 1.0 target: every locked worship target and every Skyrim-present Daedric Prince surface must be content-ready, with authored handling for every race. Phase 21 compatibility testing follows only after this roster is stable enough to test against modlists.

contentReadyForEveryRaceDefinition.rule: Every race/deity or race/Prince pairing must have explicit authored handling. Native, tolerated, foreign, taboo, hostile, and curse-access paths all require player-facing feedback when the player engages the god or Prince. Unsafe worship may remain unsafe; absence of authored handling is no longer acceptable for 1.0.

excludedDaedricPrinces.name: Jyggalag
excludedDaedricPrinces.reason: Excluded from 1.0 unless future Creation Club or Sheogorath/Jyggalag content is explicitly adopted.

phase20Slices.name: Full Skyrim-present Daedric content

phase20Slices.contentReadyDefinition: Per-Prince content-ready is decision D-18 in PDV_Architecture_v3.md Section 11.6 (rationale: references/authoring/PDV_Daedric_DecisionPacket_CAT4.md): tone, boon/price x3, tier-up + lapse, Champion entry, commitment or curse-onset, stigma (D-15) or curse-driven crossings, neglect + exit with residue, per-race response for non-native races, matrix fidelity against PDV_DaedricRacePrinceMatrix.csv, named hook source, clean pdv_content_verify with no race-manifest slot collision, and a firing-density sanity paragraph. Stigma model is D-15; curse-access template (Hircine, Molag Bal) is D-16; authoring order is D-17.
phase20Slices.voicedContentScope: Daedric content is non-voiced (MessageBox, notification, Survey, passive SPEL text), so 20C is unaffected by the V1 no-voiced-NPC-dialogue non-goal in PDV_Architecture_v3.md Section 21.3.
